rows.code: Mental Health, Substance Use Disorder, Addiction Services
rows.quote: Key informants were concerned about the use/misuse of alcohol, methamphetamines, marijuana, cocaine, and opioids.
rows.speaker: key_informant
rows.note: Community concern reported from interviews; the hospital's own prioritization is not on this page.

rows.code: Mental Health, Substance Use Disorder, Addiction Services
rows.quote: They noted more concern about suicide and suicidal ideation, noting that suicide prevention needs to be a community effort, rather than only a clinical one.
rows.speaker: key_informant
rows.note: Informant concern about suicide; not a hospital statement.

rows.code: Mental Health, Substance Use Disorder, Addiction Services
rows.quote: There have been efforts to distribute naloxone kits to prevent opioid overdoses, although there is a potential need for inpatient substance use disorder (SUD) treatment in the community.
rows.speaker: key_informant
rows.note: Who distributed naloxone is not stated, so this is coded as a reported need, not a hospital action.

rows.quote: Mental health care can also be prohibitively expensive for people, with some people not able to afford the care they need.
rows.speaker: key_informant
rows.note: Affordability of care raised by informants; no hospital financial-assistance action on this page.

rows.quote: Key informants spoke to the importance of creating a pipeline for developing the behavioral health workforce in jobs like social work.
rows.speaker: key_informant
